description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ImmutableFeaturePropertiesBuilder' which implements 'FeaturePropertiesBuilder' interface. It provides a fluent API to construct or modify ImmutableFeatureProperties objects, acting as a builder pattern around a JsonObjectBuilder. The class includes static factory methods for creating new instances, methods to set, remove, and build properties with various data types, and overrides standard object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.
